storyCards.headline: Hold It Against Me: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Britney Spears's "Hold It Against Me" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Hold It Against Me" is a song by American singer Britney Spears from her seventh studio album, Femme Fatale (2011).

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Hold It Against Me was released in 2011.
